tweets.text:
On Friday, USBP Ramey station received a report of 30 illegal aliens that were smuggled and abandoned on Mona Island, PR. A U.S. Coast Guard cutter intercepted the group and turned them over to USBP. Among them were 28 Haitian nationals & 2 Dominican Republic nationals- including one unaccompanied child. All will be charged with inadmissible aliens (8USC1182).

Reminder- The U.S. is not open for illegal immigration, don't risk your life on the treacherous journey it will only lead to apprehension and removal.

tweets.text:
CHILD PREDATOR ROUNDUP❗

Over the past three weeks, USBP, ICE, and Monroe County Sheriff's Office conducted a major operation in the Florida Keys, leading to the arrest of 10 convicted sex offenders illegally present in the U.S. All of the individuals have convictions for sex crimes against children, to include: Lewd and lascivious acts on a child, lewd and lascivious sexual battery, statutory sexual seduction, and solicitation of a child. They are now pending removal.

This operation underscores law enforcement's unwavering commitment to protecting our communities and ensuring that criminals have nowhere to hide.
